newsitem.title: USA: Huntsman MTBE unit down on operation problems.
newsitem.headline: Huntsman MTBE unit down on operation problems.

text.p: The MTBE unit at Huntsman Corp's propylene oxide/methyl tertiary butyl ether (PO/MTBE) site has come down due to an operational problem, the company said Thursday.
The Port Neches, Texas, MTBE unit, which has a rated capacity of 16,000 barrels per day, went down Wednesday for a five to seven maintenance.
"It's an easy problem to solve and we will resolve it quickly," said a company official, adding the glitch occurred in the unit's reactor sector.
The official said the company will meet all of its commitments.
Huntsman recently bought the PO/MTBE plant from Texaco Inc. but has operated the site since it opened August 1994.
